notes: Test fixture: a frozen copy of config/search.json as of 2026-11-01, the preferences the tests and dry runs are written against (tests/testenv.py points the tools here). Change config/ freely; change this file only together with the tests that depend on it.

sources.autocomplete: YouTube search suggestions (suggestqueries.google.com, ds=yt): unofficial, no key, no quota; a topic people type gets completions.
sources.youtube: YouTube Data API v3 search.list (100 quota units per call) and videos.list (1 unit): views and dates of recent relevant videos; needs the YOUTUBE_API_KEY secret.
sources.trends: Google Trends has no official API; the optional unofficial client pytrends (requirements-search.txt) is tried in isolation and recorded as unavailable when it fails.
